title: Cheeseburger Bombs

ingredients.item: cheddar cheese, plus more for the bombs

steps: Preheat. Oven to 350 °F; line a 9x13 baking sheet with parchment.
Filling. Brown the beef over medium heat, then add the onion and seasonings and cook until no longer pink and the onion is soft. Drain.
Cheese. Stir in the ketchup, turn off the heat and stir in the cheese. Cool slightly.
Dough. Unroll the crescent dough, pinch the seams into one rectangle, roll lightly and cut into 6 squares.
Fill. Add about 2 tbsp filling and a little extra cheddar to each, fold and pinch to seal, and place seam side down.
Bake. Brush with egg, add sesame seeds if you like, and bake 15 minutes until golden.
notes: Recipe fetched from the creator's linked page: feedingtinybellies.com/cheeseburger-bombs
